title: Resolve current GitHub identity for historical receipts
summary: Use verified GitHub repository identity for live lookups and preserve the original repository name inside frozen receipts.
acceptance_criteria: Rebuild the kit and OBJ/MTL archives under the current repo name without changing their stored bytes.
Verify live review evidence for an exact PR commit under the current identity.

evidence.claim: The OBJ/MTL receipt identifies the repository by its historical name.
